name: codex-sift-plugin
description: Compresses large Codex tool outputs with sift and reports saved tokens.

interface.shortDescription: Compress tool output and track saved tokens.
interface.longDescription: Uses Codex lifecycle hooks to compress large local tool outputs before the next model step, keeps lossy originals in a short-lived local stash, and exposes retrieval and savings tools through MCP.
defaultPrompt: Show how many tokens Sift has saved in this Codex session.
Explain how Sift compresses tool output in Codex.
